tools.name: split_beams_by_columns
tools.description: Split structural beams at columns (pyRevit: Cutbeambycolumn). Splits the element in place with Revit's own split where it can, so the member, its host and its parameters stay; a member Revit will not split is re-created as location-curve segments instead. Not a solid cut. Straight and curved beams, cut at the real column footprint, not a bounding box. Copies instance parameters (Mark, Comments, offsets) onto pieces it has to re-create. Params: beamIds[], columnIds[] optional (else selection; columns fall back to all in model), scope selection|visible|all, continueFrom, dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean (suffix new Marks -1, -2, ...), copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200), includeLinks boolean labelled Include linked cutters (default off; also use loaded-link cutters; hosts stay in this model). Lengths in mm.

tools.name: split_floors_by_beams
tools.description: Split floors along beam edges and add column openings (pyRevit: Cutslabbybeam). Rebuilds planar floor regions through the flooring API and carries a single-plane slope with a slope arrow; not a solid cut. Handles floors with openings, curved beams and real column footprints; a slab it cannot rebuild exactly is left alone and counted by reason. Copies instance parameters (Mark, Comments, offsets) onto new pieces. Params: floorIds[], beamIds[], columnIds[] optional (else selection; beams/columns fall back to bbox hits), scope selection|visible|all, continueFrom, dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean (suffix new Marks -1, -2, ...), copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200), includeLinks boolean labelled Include linked cutters (default off; also use loaded-link cutters; hosts stay in this model). Lengths in mm.

tools.name: split_by_levels
tools.description: Split walls, columns, beams and floors at storey elevations (Naviate-style split by levels). Curve members use FamilyInstance.Split where Revit allows it, else location-curve recreate; walls recreate the location curve; stacked and curtain walls are skipped by name. Horizontal floors skip with no-level-hit; a leaning slab is cut along the storey plane. Copies instance parameters onto re-created pieces. Params: elementIds[] optional (else scope), levelIds[] optional (else selection, then all levels), categories[] optional (walls, columns, beams, floors), scope selection|visible|all, continueFrom, dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean, copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200), includeLinks boolean labelled Include linked cutters (default off; also use loaded-link cutters; hosts stay in this model).

tools.name: split_by_grids
tools.description: Split walls, columns, beams and floors at grid lines (Naviate-style split by grids). Curve members cut on the vertical plane through each grid; floors reuse the planar region pipeline with grid lines as cutters. Copies instance parameters onto re-created pieces. Params: elementIds[] optional (else scope), gridIds[] optional (else selection, then all grids), categories[] optional (walls, columns, beams, floors), scope selection|visible|all, continueFrom, dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean, copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200), includeLinks boolean labelled Include linked cutters (default off; also use loaded-link cutters; hosts stay in this model).

tools.name: split_secondary_beams_by_main_beams
tools.description: Split a strictly-shallower beam at a same-height pass-through with a strictly deeper main. Splits the shallower beam into two pieces at the crossing, no stub inside the main. Main means strictly deeper type section height; equal depth, bearing-on, or different heights = no cut. Not a cope. Scope selection|visible|all; empty scope refuses. Params: beamIds[] optional (else scope), scope selection|visible|all, continueFrom, dryRun boolean (count only, no model changes), uniqueMark boolean (suffix new Marks -1, -2, ...), copyParams boolean (default true), limit (default 50, max 200), includeLinks boolean labelled Include linked cutters (default off; also use loaded-link cutters; hosts stay in this model). Copies instance parameters onto pieces unless copyParams is off. Lengths in mm.
